titulo: Glad you came, to the one running late
caption:
Glad you came, to the one running late

Sorry I'm late, I said. Glad you came, my friend said. Now I answer apologies the same way.

An apology for lateness asks to be forgiven, and a welcome tells the person the wait was worth it.

For whoever answers sorry I'm late with glad you came.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the left. A ink-black block figure with white eyes waits in the middle while a royal blue figure walks in from the right with narrowed eyes, and a bubble says sorry I'm late! The black one's eyes go wide and a bubble says glad you came. The blue one's eyes turn happy and then the black one's do too. The text stays: me saying glad you came, not why so late.
